layer1.interpretation: morula->blastocyst has same ~20% R2 as 8cell->morula (R2=0.200 vs 0.228). The critical failure: 39.7% of morula-zero DMRs re-methylate at blastocyst (n=31/156), which is structurally unpredictable by any methylation-only operator. This is analogous to the 8cell->morula occupancy failure (0.044 vs 0.875).

layer2.interpretation: Raw rho = -0.1729. After controlling for morula methylation (x_morula), partial rho = -0.1108 (64% signal retention). Partial rho not significant after control (perm_p=0.092, null_q05=-0.1348). Independent component of accessibility on blastocyst correction is mediated through morula methylation.

layer3.interpretation: Morula bimodality is robust across thresholds 0.0-0.02 (morula highest at each threshold). CpG coverage confound not detected. Recommended: report 'fully or near-fully demethylated (beta<=0.02)': morula=85/156 (54.5%), confirmed stable with n_cpg>=3 filter (n=34).
